description.value: A tidy, flower-lined adult-only RV park on the edge of Creston with large level tent sites and clean heated washrooms; walking distance to grocery stores, pharmacy, and pool, making it a practical town stop with no scenic draw.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content at scottiesrv.com was successfully fetched and corroborates OSM data on address, phone, and core amenities. The amenities subpage explicitly confirms heated showers, laundry, and no-service tent sites ('13 no-service', 'great for tenting'), matching OSM tags (shower=yes, tents=yes, drinking_water=yes). The rates page labels the property 'Creston's Only Adult RV Park,' which may indicate age restrictions and is worth flagging; additionally, the OSM name includes an apostrophe ('Scotty's') while the website consistently omits it ('Scotties').
concerns: Name discrepancy: OSM records 'Scotty's RV Park & Campground' (with apostrophe) but the website consistently uses 'Scotties RV Park & Campground' (no apostrophe).
Rates page labels the property 'Creston's Only Adult RV Park' — a possible age restriction not elaborated elsewhere on the site; could affect some touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate year-round campground with confirmed tent sites, free heated showers, laundry, potable water, and walking-distance access to Creston's town amenities — a solid stop for touring cyclists on the International Selkirk Loop corridor.

wow_evidence: heated showers, laundry, and no-service tent sites
